text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation fired -> manager paged: carla. Alert PD-99101 for service=hosted-inference-prod. Primary oncall (ops-oncall) unacked ~3m, secondary (mira) unacked ~5m; manager escalation triggered. Trigger: sustained 5xx rate >5% for 3m. Details: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-99101 

carla: I just got the manager page and the SMS. Joining bridge now. Any customer-facing impact? :phone: 

ops-oncall: sorry team — driving, phone was in DND so I didn't ack earlier. Just saw the page. Looking at dashboards now, 5xx spike across us-west clusters, cpu on gpu-host-3 very high. 

mira: weird — I didn't get the initial SMS either, carrier shows blocked delivery. Can join in ~2m. We also don't have ALB error logs forwarded for the last 5m (ingest lag). 

jun: on the bridge, tailing app logs. Deploy went at 02:07 UTC to canary subset. I'm seeing model init failures/OOMs on a subset of pods right after that. Sample log: ```[2026-03-15T02:08:12Z] host=gpu-03 process=redwood-infer level=error msg="OOM killer invoked, exiting" pid=1442``` 

carla: if it's OOMs on some nodes we can route traffic away from those hosts or shift to smaller model variant. What's the quickest safe mitigation? 

sam: initiating manual routing to standby pool now — command: ```curl -X POST https://internal-routing/api/route -d '{"service":"hosted-inference-prod","target":"standby-pool"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>'``` 

incident-bot: Manager override applied by sam. Routing policy updated: hosted-inference-prod -> standby-pool (manual override). Action ID ACT-4421. Note: this bypasses automated fallback, tracked in incident log. 

ops-oncall: traffic shifting in progress. 10% -> standby in first batch, will increment to 100% if stable. Monitoring latency and 5xx. 

mira: after shifting 30% we see 5xx drop from 6.8% -> 1.2% within 90s. Looks like faulty subset isolated. Recommend keep on standby until we validate canary and redeploy with memory fix. 

carla: documenting customer impact: estimated 2.3% of total requests failed between 02:07–02:15 UTC, affecting a few enterprise tenants (billing/ingest paths). Ops: please open an incident ticket and escalate to customer success if SLAs hit. 

sam: created ticket INC-2026-58 and started a status page draft. Also adding PD audit (who was paged and timestamps). 

jun: action items: (1) rollback or rebuild image with memory fix on canary nodes, (2) add early high-memory watermark alert, (3) vendor follow-up for SMS gateway. Also propose PD policy changes: extend primary TTL 3->4m and add voice fallback for critical services. 

mira: +1 on SMS vendor follow-up — my phone carrier logs show blocking in that window, which caused the secondary miss and led to manager escalation. We'll include contact details in the postmortem. 

carla: thanks everyone. I'll lead the postmortem writeup. Please add timeline entries and attach routing/action logs (Action ACT-4421, PD-99101). We'll keep this thread for follow-ups then close. :white_check_mark:
